text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

**1. Reps got their evenings back.** Admin time after calls dropped by about a third. Nobody missed typing up recaps from the car.

**2. CRM data got better, not just faster.** Next steps and objections were captured consistently, so pipeline reviews stopped relying on memory.

**3. Consent matters.** Some customers hesitated. Reps who asked upfront and explained the purpose earned trust. Those who didn't lost it.

**4. Summaries aren't strategy.** The tool captured what was said. Reps still had to decide what it meant.

**5. Coaching improved.** Managers could review real conversations instead of guessing.

We're extending the pilot to a second region.

What has your team learned from AI note-takers?
